components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:28px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#d4d5ce);margin:29px 0 26px}.ds-tabs button{font-family:Haas,Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink,#20221f);font-size:15px;background:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;padding:13px 0;margin-bottom:-1px;color:var(--muted,#60635b);cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{border-color:var(--ink,#20221f);color:var(--ink,#20221f)}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#566340);outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-tabs{margin:23px 0}}

components.name: Comparison action
components.description: Small text action, shown in both available and added states.

components.description: Native labelled checkboxes with olive selection and a muted disabled label.

components.name: Spectrum marks
components.description: Five qualitative positions, with one selected olive mark and descriptive accessible text.

components.css: .ds-row{font-family:Haas,Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink,#20221f);display:grid;grid-template-columns:130px 1fr;align-items:center;min-height:54px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#d4d5ce);font-size:14px}.ds-row a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-row a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-row a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#566340);outline-offset:5px}.ds-track{height:24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);align-items:center;position:relative}.ds-track:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:10%;right:10%;height:1px;background:var(--rule,#d4d5ce);top:50%}.ds-slot{height:4px;width:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--rule,#d4d5ce);position:relative;justify-self:center}.ds-slot.ds-selected{height:12px;width:12px;background:var(--accent,#566340);outline:4px solid var(--bg,#f2f2f0)}

components.css: .ds-entry{font-family:Haas,Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink,#20221f);min-width:0}.ds-image{display:block;overflow:hidden;background:var(--image-ground,#e3e4dc)}.ds-image img{display:block;width:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:53% 45%;aspect-ratio:4/5;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.ds-image:hover img{transform:scale(1.025)}.ds-entry a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-entry a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-entry a:focus-visible,.ds-entry button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#566340);outline-offset:5px}.ds-heading{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:15px;gap:10px}.ds-heading h2{font-size:22px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:0}.ds-entry-compare{font-family:Haas,Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink,#20221f);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#60635b);padding:8px 0;flex-shrink:0;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-entry-compare[aria-pressed=true]{color:var(--accent,#566340);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#60635b);margin-top:14px;padding-top:11px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#d4d5ce)}.ds-meta a{color:var(--ink,#20221f)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-image img{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A restrained studio research archive, following the user’s 19 studio / Chocolate studio references. The neutral grey ground and Haas typography let brand photography provide the strongest visual variation. Short readings, open entries and fine rules keep the interface precise and legible.

Controls remain visible as text, underlines and native checkboxes. The composition is flat and quiet, with muted olive reserved for selection and emphasis. Sans-serif typography, visible navigation and minimal, non-redundant copy are durable commitments.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral grey ground and graphite text.
Open photographic entries separated by fine rules.
Visible text controls with restrained olive state cues.

rules.name: The Photograph First Rule
rules.body: Keep the interface palette quiet so the featured photography carries the visual variation.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Haas for headings, body and controls; preserve Arial and sans-serif as fallbacks.

rules.name: The Flat Archive Rule
rules.body: Separate content with space and fine rules, without elevated card shells.

dos: Do keep all four main navigation links visible at narrow widths.
Do pair real photography with concise readings and source credits.
Do distinguish selected states with the existing underline, border or olive mark.
Do preserve semantic links, tabs, checkbox labels and keyboard focus.
donts: Don’t introduce hamburger navigation or serif typography.
Don’t add decorative panels, heavy shadows or rounded card shells.
Don’t repeat headings with redundant eyebrows or ornamental labels.
Don’t turn illustrative brand palettes into interface theme colors.
